reference_deductions_review.audit: The supplied estimate concerns uniform variables. The reference applies it to arbitrary possibly atomic D without the quantile coupling reduction. The missing concentration justification is real.
The packing primitive returns objective at least P(H)/2, not h/2. A cycle disproves P(H)>=h. The claimed16-crossing witness and dependent exactness are not established.
The reference assumes surviving-component identifiers that the problem expressly does not supply. It does not recover them from the distributed edge log.
A bounded query family closed under coordinate relabeling does not make each query invariant. A further invariance argument is needed, so the distinguishing-query contradiction is not proved.
